descriptions.Marketing Leadership: CMO, VP Marketing, Head of Marketing, Growth VP, Brand Director, and other executive marketing leaders.
descriptions.Marketing Operations: MarTech Lead, Marketing Ops, Performance CoE Lead, managing marketing technology and execution systems.
descriptions.Demand Generation: Performance Marketing, Paid Media Lead, Acquisition Lead, focused on outbound growth and customer acquisition.
descriptions.Revenue Operations: RevOps, Sales Ops, CRM Operations, aligning marketing and sales data/systems.
descriptions.Partnerships: Alliance Lead, Partnerships Director, managing strategic channels and alliances.
descriptions.Customer Success: Customer Success Director, CS Lead, focused on post-sale customer retention and growth.
descriptions.Enterprise Sales: Key Account Director, B2B Enterprise Director, outbound corporate sales.
descriptions.Channel Sales: Channel Director, Retail Sales Director, indirect distribution sales.
descriptions.Engineering: CTO, VP of Engineering, Solutions Architect, Software Developer, and other core technical roles.
descriptions.Product: VP Product, CPO, Product Manager, orchestrating product lifecycle and roadmaps.
descriptions.HR: Chief People Officer, HR Director, Recruiter, managing talent and people operations.
descriptions.Finance: CFO, Finance Controller, Financial Analyst, managing corporate treasury and accounting.
descriptions.General Management: CEO, COO, Chief of Staff, holding overall corporate administration responsibility.
descriptions.Consulting: Partner, Strategy Consultant, Management Consultant, advising on corporate strategy.
descriptions.Other: Out-of-scope roles such as administrative assistants, legal counsel, or operations managers.
